welcome.title: Welcome to Frontdoor
welcome.body: This is your Home page, your starting point. From here, you can search for, browse, and access the tools and services available to you.

search.title: Find apps quickly
search.body: Use the search function to filter by name, description, or tag. The Favorites, Grouping, and View buttons help you customize the catalog to suit your tastes and needs.

catalog.title: Browse the catalog
catalog.body: Open an app by clicking on its title, icon, or description. Add the ones you use most often to your favorites.

appCards.title: Favorites and details
appCards.body: Each app card includes a star icon for your favorites and an info icon when there are extra details to read. Use the star to save the apps you use most and the info icon to discover helpful details.

reorder.title: Reorder the cards
reorder.body: When you're in card view, you can drag each card from the icon in the top-left corner to reorder it however you like. In compact view, custom reordering is not available: switch to card view, sort your apps, then switch back to compact if you want. Your custom order is saved to your profile.

menuButton.title: Find the menu button
menuButton.body: On mobile, the hamburger button in the top right opens your personal menu. Take a look at it first, then we'll open it in the next step.

menu.title: Your personal menu
menu.body: Open this menu to customize the default Home view, language, theme, and, when available, your custom app order too. If you change your mind, you can restore each setting from here.

homepage.title: Bring Frontdoor with you
homepage.body: To keep it close at hand, you can set Frontdoor as your homepage or bookmark it in your browser. The right guide is listed below for the browser you're using.

tour.browserDocsHint: We put the guide for the browser you're using first.
